full_prompt_en: A square painterly cityscape looks down a narrow old street lined with tall masonry buildings and dotted with pedestrians and early cars. The road begins wide at the lower edge and rises gently toward a bright opening in the distance. On the left, ochre and reddish facades stand in close sequence, their windows and cornices suggested by firm vertical strokes and small dark rectangles. On the right, darker buildings lean into shadow, with projecting signs and warm window glows visible near street level. A few boxy black cars sit or move along the lower and middle road, their simple silhouettes anchoring the historical setting without readable makes or signs. Small figures walk along both sides and cross the middle distance; they are loosely painted, recognizable by posture more than facial detail. The far end of the street is framed by pale gray and cream buildings that recede into hazy light. The sky appears only as a narrow warm strip above the rooftops. Thick, broken brush marks articulate the road, walls, and moving figures, leaving many details deliberately soft. Warm browns, muted gold, slate gray, and black dominate, with occasional pale highlights on the road and upper walls. Light enters from beyond the street and slightly above, brightening the distant center while the near right side remains in deeper shadow. Uneven reflections or pale scuffs on the roadway add a little movement to the foreground. The overall composition draws the eye uphill through converging facades and scattered human scale, giving the street a lived-in, nostalgic warmth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带绘画感的城市风景沿一条狭窄旧街望去，两侧是高大的砖石建筑，路上散布行人与早期汽车。道路从下沿宽阔展开，缓缓升向远处明亮的出口。左侧赭黄和赤褐立面紧挨着排列，窗户与檐口由坚实竖向笔触和小暗色矩形暗示。右侧较暗的楼房沉入阴影，临街处可见凸出的招牌形状和暖色窗光。几辆方正的黑车位于下方和中段道路上，简单剪影固定旧时街景，却没有可读车牌或标志。小人物沿两边行走，并从中景横过；他们被松散描绘，姿态比面部细节更可辨。街道远端由浅灰和奶油色建筑围合，建筑退入朦胧亮光中。天空只在屋顶上方露出一条窄窄的暖色带。厚实、破碎的笔痕描出道路、墙面和行人，许多细节有意保持柔化。暖棕、柔金、石板灰和黑色占主导，路面与高处墙面偶有浅亮点。光从街道尽头略偏上方进入，照亮远处中央，让近处右侧保持较深阴影。路面不均匀的反光或浅色磨痕在前景增添一点动势。整体构图以汇聚的立面和散落的人体尺度引导视线向街道上坡延伸，赋予街景有人生活过的怀旧暖意。
style_prompt_en: Painterly urban realism uses brisk, broken strokes to suggest dense built surfaces and movement without polishing every detail. Ochre, warm brown, slate gray, and muted cream are organized around a bright receding center and darker framing sides. Vertical marks establish structure, while small dark accents and rough horizontal scuffs animate lower planes. Hazy distance softens edges and lowers contrast; near shapes remain heavier and more legible. Light filters along the main depth axis, catching selected upper and ground surfaces while leaving deep warm shadow between them. The overall rhythm is lively, weathered, and atmospheric.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式城市写实用明快破碎的笔触暗示密集实体表面与运动，不把每个细节磨得光滑。赭黄、暖棕、石板灰和柔和奶油色围绕明亮的后退中心与较暗两侧组织。竖向笔痕建立结构，小型深色强调和粗糙横向擦痕让下方平面活跃起来。朦胧远景软化边缘并降低反差；近处形状更厚重、更易辨。光沿主要纵深轴渗入，击中部分高处和地面表面，同时在其间留下深暖阴影。整体节奏活跃、风化且富于氛围。
theme_en: An old city street with pedestrians and early cars in warm light
theme_zh: 暖光中的旧城街道、行人与早期汽车
name: David Tutwiler
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
